name: Jump Rope
steps: Stand with the rope behind your heels and a handle beside each hip, keeping your elbows near your ribs.
Swing the rope smoothly forward overhead using quick circular turns of your wrists rather than wide arm circles.
Hop lightly off the balls of your feet just high enough for the rope to pass cleanly beneath you, landing softly with slightly bent knees.
Continue hopping in rhythm, then let the rope come to rest behind you.
tips: Keep your jumps low and springy rather than tucking your knees high on every pass.
Turn the rope primarily from your wrists while keeping your shoulders relaxed and elbows close to your ribs.
